source_evidence: D327~15:40 exact player 'Now' answers Tavosk's explicit question whether to commission the first advance inspection notice now or wait for a consignment, following V's approval of the quoted6gp price. Authorizes this specific commission and payment only. V pays Tavosk6gp from personal purse2047gp8sp6cp→2041gp8sp6cp, no additional fees, continuing agreement, consignment, false declaration, shipment or signature. Tavosk accepts the six gold pieces and confirms he will provide the first advance notice concerning an Orsaven berth inspection when he obtains it. He voluntarily issues a brief signed receipt, 'Received six gold pieces from Lord Vaishnavi for commercial information. Noldren Tavosk.' Generic wording does not itself identify confidential inspection information; all three companions witnessed the actual context and payment. Receipt offered and V retains it as ordinary transaction custody. Tavosk asks where he should deliver the notice. No inspection date, actual warning, completed service, delivery address, new payer identity, immunity, fee schedule or future result established. Cirren's earlier advice against commitment remains his own view; he observes this transaction without endorsing it. No additional roll or feature expenditure. Desen has not yet learned the afternoon developments or payment. Await V reply.
